title: Heathrow warns of second day of disruption after cyber-attack
summary: The issue affecting check-in and baggage systems caused hundreds of delays and cancellations on Saturday.

title: Delays continue at Heathrow, Brussels and Berlin airports after alleged cyber-attack
summary: Airlines reverted to manual check-in since Friday after service provider hit by ‘cyber-related incident’ Passengers at London Heathrow airport and those in Brussels and Berlin faced another day of delays on Sunday after an alleged cyber-attack hit check-in desk software . Airlines were forced to revert to manual check-in from Friday night after the alleged attack hit Collins Aerospace, which provides check-in desk technology to various airlines. Continue reading...
